screening_conclusion: User-corrected railway issue window is Apr 22–24, superseding approximate Apr 20. WSA Apr 17 and Apr 18 warnings were published 5 and 4 calendar days before the start of this window. Apr 23 Foam Lake coverage is contemporaneous with the window but outside mapped Birch Creek gross basin. Elfros Apr 23 declaration falls within the window, with original public timestamp absent and available news Apr 29/30. No in-basin social post verified before first railway impact; exact gauge peak and impact timestamps remain unverified. Further social-source research found five specific leads, with one timestamp recovered (June 30, excluded). Historical group-post coverage is incomplete; do not interpret zero verified qualifying posts as proof that early upstream reports did not exist.
